name: broker-marker-ctrl-l
description: The broker marker for a ctrl_l answer, and the input frame that follows it. The marker (sidecar code 5, data the x-broker-line line for choice ctrl_l) stands before the code-1 input frame carrying 0x0C, because the core records an input frame before it sends it (Contract §13): the recording shows the broker sent Ctrl-L on the session's behalf, and that the byte the target sees is the core's, not a client's. Who chose is on the session.stale_choice audit event. A leader that records the input before the marker would hide that the broker originated the byte.
